title: Settings
language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the display language for the TeamCow interface. Provider output, diffs, and git information are not translated.
language.note: Provider output, file content, diffs, and git messages remain in their original language.
theme.title: Appearance
theme.description: Choose how TeamCow looks. Follow system matches your macOS appearance.
theme.note: The theme applies to the whole app and is remembered across restarts.
theme.change-failed: Failed to save the appearance setting.
editor.title: Coding editor
editor.description: Choose the installed coding tool TeamCow should use for file and worktree handoff.
editor.note: Only installed editors can be selected. TeamCow opens the inspected conversation target with this editor.
editor.change-failed: Failed to save the editor selection.
updates.title: Updates
updates.description: Check for a new TeamCow build and restart when an update has been downloaded.
updates.status.idle: No update check has run yet
updates.error: Update check failed. This is a local update integration issue, not provider or network readiness.
updates.install-failed: Restart update failed. Your local projects and conversation history remain untouched.
updates.note: Updates do not affect imported projects, worktrees, or local conversation history.
